Partial discrepancy: upregulated gene lists (status = up_regulated) are present in the provided DESeq2 CSVs so overlaps can be computed, but the provided excerpts appear truncated here so I cannot independently verify the exact numerical overlaps and the central '50% / 1483' count shown in the figure without the full gene lists.

no discrepancies found: the log2 TPM matrix (2C_overlapping_up_targets_log2TPM.csv) and the stat_test file are provided, which enable reproduction of the violin distributions and the reported statistical annotations (adjusted P-values).

replicability out of context: RPKM-normalized genome-browser track files (bigWig/bedgraph or per-base coverage) are not provided, so numeric reconstruction of the displayed RNA-seq tracks is not possible from the tabular CSVs.

Partial replication: the provided file '3AB_diff_expression.csv' contains per-gene log2FC columns and cluster labels allowing reproduction of the fold-change heatmap, but it does not include chromatin-state assignments or TAD-windowed positional signal matrices (±3 kb) nor the explicit gene lists/p-value or threshold rules used to define the upregulated target sets and Venn counts, so the chromatin-state heatmap, TAD-centered heatmaps, and exact overlap numbers cannot be fully reproduced.

Partial replication: '3AB_diff_expression.csv' provides per-gene log2 fold-changes for the KD conditions (sufficient to recreate simple fold-change heatmaps), but it lacks the TAD-centered windowed coverage matrices or positional coverage data (±3 kb around TAD boundaries) and does not provide replicate-level signals or statistical thresholds used to define clusters, so the exact TAD-centered heatmaps shown cannot be fully reproduced.
